name: What are the advantages of buying a luxury new construction home versus an existing luxury home in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying a luxury new construction home versus an existing luxury home in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a luxury new construction home often means modern design, the latest smart home technology, and brand-new appliances and systems, typically requiring less immediate maintenance. However, existing luxury homes often come with established landscaping, unique character, and may be situated in highly sought-after, fully developed neighborhoods where new construction is limited, such as certain parts of Coral Gables or Coconut Grove. The tradeoff involves balancing immediate move-in readiness and customization potential with established location and character. Your agent can help weigh these factors based on your priorities.
acceptedAnswer.description: New luxury construction offers modern design and less maintenance, while existing homes provide established character and prime locations. The choice depends on balancing these tradeoffs.
